list-of-amateur-radio-call-signs.xlsx.contentsIndicative: one worksheet, 'Reserved Callsigns 23-10-2020': header Value,Status,Type,Call Sign MMSI: Created Date,Call Sign MMSI: Last Modified Date,Reserved to Date,Licence Cancel Date then 50,524 data rows. Status 50,260 Reserved and 264 Available (the stray Available rows are preserved, not reconciled to the 'Reserved' title). Type is 'Call Sign - Amateur' on every row. Created Date and Last Modified Date populated on every row (2016-07-23 to 2020-10-23); Reserved to Date on 93 rows (a reservation expiry, values reaching 2022); Licence Cancel Date on 7,397 rows, reaching back to 1932-01-26. Anomalies preserved verbatim: one blank callsign; three callsigns (20FEB, 20AUG, 20NOV) mangled by Excel into date serials 2020-02-20, 2020-08-20, 2020-11-20; 84 four-character heritage callsigns and a run of over-length reciprocal M/... forms including M/M/PT2FM.

raw-extract-sheet-1-reserved-callsigns-2.contentsIndicative: mechanical extract of the sole worksheet; the seven-column header then 50,524 rows, dates rendered ISO from their stored serials. All anomalies preserved verbatim (blank callsign, three Excel-date-mangled callsigns, heritage four-character and over-length reciprocal callsigns).

normalised--sheet-1-reserved-callsigns-2.contentsIndicative: header callsign,status,licence_class,created_date,last_modified_date,reserved_to_date,licence_cancel_date; 50,524 rows sorted by callsign (source order carries no meaning). Status carried verbatim (50,260 Reserved, 264 Available - a genuine per-row column, not a declared attribution); licence_class emitted empty (no product/class disclosed; the constant Type discriminator is required-present but not carried). Dates carried ISO where present: created_date and last_modified_date on every row, reserved_to_date on 93 rows (futureAllowed - a reservation expiry), licence_cancel_date on 7,397 rows (bounded by the vintage, oldest 1932-01-26). The one blank callsign sorts first; the three Excel-date-mangled callsigns (2020-02-20, 2020-08-20, 2020-11-20) are preserved verbatim in the callsign column. Blank counts recorded in the converter notes.
